minor.issue: Public unauthenticated endpoint returns full order details by ID for ANY caller who knows the ObjectId. Not a V4 regression (pre-existing) but with V4 customer isolation feature it becomes a data-privacy concern. Consider requiring customer JWT for orders that have customer_id, or scope to short-lived order_number token.

When un-paying (belum_dibayar/dp), reverse_referral_points also refunds redeemed points to buyer. If admin later re-marks lunas, redeem is NOT re-charged (buyer keeps refund AND still gets order at redeemed total). Consider re-charging or blocking un-pay when points_redeemed_le>0.

Refunds points_redeemed_le with $inc points_available:+redeemed and $inc points_redeemed:-redeemed. If buyer already spent those points on another order in between, points_available could reasonably still be positive but points_redeemed lifetime counter goes negative. Cosmetic.

Only manage_settings-gated. No dedicated permission for referral program management — any admin with manage_settings can mutate referral discount_percentage/points_per_order affecting all customer codes. Acceptable per spec but note.

action_items: (Optional, security) Restrict GET /api/orders/{id} — currently public; combine with customer JWT or use unguessable order token when customer_id is set.
(Optional) In PATCH un-pay flow: either block un-pay when points_redeemed_le>0, or re-charge redeemed points on subsequent re-lunas so buyers can’t double-benefit.
(Optional) Enforce max_total_points cap in award_referral_points partially instead of skipping the whole award when it would overflow (currently silently skips — no UI feedback).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py now 1743 lines — long overdue to split into routers (auth, customers, orders, admin_orders, products, finance, referral, points).
record_order_revenue guards against duplicate revenue via find_one on related_order_id+type=order_revenue → correctly idempotent; delete uses delete_many which is safe.

award_referral_points is idempotent via existing 'earn' point_transaction lookup; reverse_referral_points inserts a 'reverse' txn AND deletes the 'earn' — this is fine but means a re-award after reverse would fire (order re-marked lunas post-reverse). Verify intended: yes, reverse deletes earn so next lunas can re-award. Currently no state guards against toggling lunas repeatedly to farm points, but per-order idempotency between reverse→re-award still gates one award per state cycle (acceptable).
validate_referral end_date+'T23:59:59' concat assumes date-only string; same issue flagged in V3 for discounts. Consider strict parsing.

Customer cookies use samesite=none;secure=true (correct for cross-site preview) but there is no server-side JWT revocation — logout only clears cookie client-side; stolen token remains valid until 30-day expiry.

point_redeem cap uses subtotal_le (before discount); when a referral discount also applies, effective % of paid subtotal can exceed intended max_pct — matches spec that redemption caps by subtotal not total, but worth documenting.
